answer: Vest influence over wall-clock epochs instead of granting it at mint. A fresh key is a green walnut: it must age across many closes before its vote hardens like quartz, and a decay clock prunes any identity that goes dormant. Sybils want weight today, but aging refuses because time cannot be forged or fast-forwarded. A farm flooding keys like juniper seedlings finds each one weightless for weeks and most pruned before maturing, so keeping an aged army alive costs far more than it ever returns.
